robot.diagnosis: The actual outline explicitly says Left/Right. The fresh semantic pass chose center for both; geometry was constrained to preserve those choices. Positive available X/Y spread rules out zero-spread collapse. The two sphere meshes overlap, explaining the single visible yellow eye without a renderer assumption.

The runner received the error and metadata only; no token/content callback was enabled. Process exited and no replay is authorized.
whale.dataBoundary: The first planned node is whale_body mesh and the plan has another mesh plus three extrusions, but the final open array/node is unobservable. Do not label declared maxima as actual generated counts.
whale.actualTextCompletionAlsoUnknown: No rejected buffer was returned. Length termination and grammarTerminated=false do not alone distinguish an open/truncated array from a complete JSON object followed by whitespace without accepted EOS.

This batch does not prove which whale array caused its cap; all original maxima can remain admission bounds. Because the whale text is unavailable, this is not proof that an observed array ran to its maximum; exact-count schema also does not by itself bound numeric literal length or whitespace.
